semantics.rounding_saturation: Same RN ties-to-even and satfinite operation on each unchanged FP32 input.
semantics.byte_order: PTX a maps to upper8 and b to lower8; e4m3x4f passes x1,x0 then x3,x2, producing x0,x1,x2,x3 in ascending bytes. uint2 stores remain unchanged.
semantics.nan_signed_zero: Both scalar and paired forms apply the same per-lane hardware conversion. Equivalence does not depend on inventing a particular NaN sign/payload canonicalization. Signed-zero inputs and overflow inputs see the same conversion semantics; no FP16 intermediate or new arithmetic is introduced.
semantics.cpu_limit: A host FP8 oracle or PTX shim can check packing/order/boundaries but does not execute the actual GPU instruction or establish generated SASS.

The source changes eight scalar call sites to four packed conversion instructions per live eight-value chunk. Actual ptxas scalar-combining, instruction savings and exposed latency are unknown.

No new memory traffic, synchronization, decode work or geometry is introduced. This supports one cheap fixed experiment despite likely modest scope; no gain forecast follows.

root_predeclared_screen.aggregate: For each of six loads and each run, sum46*baseline_ns_sliding+16*baseline_ns_full divided by sum46*median_ns_sliding+16*median_ns_full. Official problem score is geometric mean of these six load speedups. Candidate score / each exact parent score >=1.005.
root_predeclared_screen.breadth: At least3 of6 weighted-load speedup ratios are >1 against BOTH exact parents jointly.
root_predeclared_screen.individual_regression: For every case and each parent, parent paired speedup / candidate paired speedup <=1.02.
root_predeclared_screen.validity: Complete clean official correctness, benchmark/profile and provenance records; no candidate promotion from diagnostic or incomplete evidence.
root_predeclared_screen.uncertainty: Operational screen, not statistical significance; intervals may overlap and cross-run seed/node drift remains.
root_predeclared_screen.failure_policy: Close this fixed attempt if it fails; no conversion-policy sweep or measurement-seeking repeat.
root_predeclared_screen.descriptive_only: Decode/verify/sliding/full subgroups may be reported descriptively; they do not replace or add performance gates.
